compiled_state.title: Implement Provider Protocol, OpenAI provider, and full Mock provider
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
DD1: providers/ exposes Anthropic and OpenAI behind common interface
DD3: mock provider proves extensibility (3rd implementation)

## Implementation
1. providers/base.py — typing.Protocol:
   class Provider(Protocol):
       def review_diff(self, diff_text: str, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]: ...

2. providers/openai.py — wraps litellm.completion:
   - model default: "openai/gpt-4o-mini"
   - Same pattern as anthropic.py (deferred litellm import, system msg in messages list)
   - Raises ValueError on JSON parse failure (matching anthropic.py behavior)

3. providers/mock.py — replace stub with full implementation:
   class MockProvider:
       def review_diff(self, diff_text: str, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
           return {"findings": [], "mock": True}
   # No litellm import; deterministic; test-only

AC for F2 pre-verification: run before implementing openai.py:
  python3 -c "import litellm; litellm.completion(model='openai/gpt-4o-mini', messages=[{'role':'user','content':'hi'}], mock_response='ok')" 
If fails, add explicit openai pin to pyproject.toml and flag for T5.

.test-index: remove RED marker for openai.py after implementing; update mapping

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh passes (all provider unit tests GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] ruff check passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Provider Protocol importable
  Verify: PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts python3 -c "from dso_ci_review.providers.base import Provider"
- [ ] OpenAI provider importable and has review_diff
  Verify: PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts python3 -c "from dso_ci_review.providers.openai import OpenAIProvider; assert hasattr(OpenAIProvider(), 'review_diff')"
- [ ] MockProvider returns deterministic findings
  Verify: PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts python3 -c "from dso_ci_review.providers.mock import MockProvider; r=MockProvider().review_diff('diff'); assert 'findings' in r"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
